question.text: Which of the following statement(s) is/are correct about the given compound?

options.text: It does not react with metallic sodium
It gives reddish-violet coloration with $\mathrm{FeCl}_3$ solution
It gives precipitate with 2,4-dinitrophenyl hydrazine solution

solution.text: (C) It gives reddish violet coloration with $\mathrm{FeCl}_3$ solution due to enol content. (D) It gives DNP Test due to presence of Keto group.
